## Downloads

Use the attached Windows native installer/portable archive or Android APK. Android updates must use `com.follow.fclash` and the existing FClash release certificate. Development/safe-mode packages are not production releases.

## Validation

Record native tests, platform builds, signing/ABI checks, device verification and remaining limitations. Do not claim memory improvements without a comparable benchmark.
